description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an OIC / HCM Developer based in the United States. 

 This remote opportunity is ideal for an Oracle integration developer looking to contribute to a major enterprise HR technology transformation. You will build, enhance, and support integrations and extensions for Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) Cloud using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Working under the technical guidance of a senior developer, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements and implementation to testing, deployment, and production support. Your work will connect HR systems with internal and third-party applications, supporting essential processes such as recruiting, onboarding, payroll, benefits, and workforce administration. You will collaborate with HCM functional teams, technical specialists, and external implementation partners while expanding your expertise in Oracle technologies, APIs, and cloud integration. The role offers hands-on development experience within a collaborative, enterprise-scale digital transformation environment.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Develop and maintain Oracle integrations



 
 Design, develop, test, and deploy integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), following established technical designs and development standards.



 
 Work with scheduled, application-driven, and file-based integration patterns.



 
 Build and enhance integrations between Oracle HCM Cloud and internal or third-party applications.



 
 Support business processes across recruiting, onboarding, core HR, benefits, payroll, and learning systems.





 
 Support identity and user provisioning



 
 Develop and maintain integrations between Oracle HCM and directory services, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.



 
 Support automated identity and provisioning workflows for employee hires, transfers, and terminations.



 
 Help ensure accurate and reliable employee data synchronization across connected systems.





 
 Build and support Oracle HCM data solutions



 
 Develop and maintain HCM Extracts to support data exchange and downstream processing.



 
 Configure and support HCM Data Loader (HDL/HSDL) data loads.



 
 Develop and maintain Fast Formulas to support business and functional requirements.



 
 Assist with data feeds and reporting integrations involving Databricks and Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI).





 
 Develop and test API and file-based integrations



 
 Consume Oracle HCM REST APIs and SOAP web services to support system connectivity.



 
 Build, test, and troubleshoot API requests using tools such as Postman.



 
 Support secure file-based integrations, including SFTP transfers, PGP encryption and decryption, and SSH key-based connectivity.





 
 Collaborate across technical and functional teams



 
 Work under the technical direction of the Senior OIC Developer and collaborate with HCM functional teams, the Oracle HCM system management team, and external implementation partners.



 
 Contribute across the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.



 
 Communicate technical issues and integration requirements clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.



 
 Continue developing expertise in OIC, Oracle HCM, APIs, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).






 Requirements


 
 Solid foundational experience with Oracle HCM Cloud and integration development.



 
 Practical knowledge or experience developing integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).



 
 Understanding of integration patterns, including scheduled, application-driven, and file-based integrations.



 
 Familiarity with Oracle HCM modules and business processes such as recruiting, onboarding, core HR, benefits, payroll, and learning.



 
 Experience or working knowledge of Oracle HCM integration tools and capabilities, including:



 
 HCM Extracts.



 
 HCM Data Loader (HDL/HSDL).



 
 Fast Formulas.



 
 Oracle HCM REST APIs and SOAP web services.





 
 Familiarity with API development and testing tools such as Postman.



 
 Understanding of secure file transfer and connectivity technologies, including SFTP, PGP encryption/decryption, and SSH key-based authentication.



 
 Exposure to identity and provisioning integrations involving Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID is beneficial.



 
 Familiarity with Databricks, Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), and enterprise reporting or data feeds is an advantage.



 
 Ability to contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support.



 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate integration issues and identify practical solutions.



 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.



 
 Willingness to learn new technologies, expand Oracle expertise, and work under the guidance of senior technical colleagues.



 
 Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, remote environment.




 Benefits


 
 Annual salary range: USD $120,000–$130,000.



 
 Full-time employee position.



 
 Remote working arrangement.



 
 Opportunity to contribute to a broad Oracle HCM transformation initiative.



 
 Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Cloud, APIs, and cloud-based integration technologies.



 
 Collaboration with experienced technical developers, functional teams, and implementation partners.



 
 Opportunities to expand technical capabilities and develop professionally within a digital engineering environment.
